title: Spyglass is Live!
summary: Spyglass is officially live, providing every user with powerful new insights and streamlined workflows.

title: Improved File Handling and Presentation
summary: Effortlessly manage your embedded images and files with new intuitive controls, allowing you to customize their display and maintain perfect control over your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap page where you can easily follow our progress, explore recently shipped features, and see what exciting updates are planned next.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Tools
summary: We've made it easier and more intuitive to collaborate with your team, enhancing your shared workflow and productivity.

title: Unlock Collaborative Potential
summary: We've made it significantly easier to share and discover all relevant items with your collaborators, enhancing teamwork and productivity.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Discover Noeko in new languages, designed to make our powerful platform more accessible and inclusive for everyone, everywhere.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Get ready to collaborate and innovate as Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and transparency over its future development.

title: Dynamic Constellation: Enhanced Filtering & Sharing
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and collaboration, thanks to new filtering options by tags, time, and shared items in your Constellation view.

title: Powerful Search Filters & Personalized Compendiums
summary: Discover, filter, and organize your information with unprecedented precision by saving custom search queries as personalized Compendiums.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Organize your thoughts with unprecedented clarity through dynamic content layouts that offer flexible viewing modes and enhanced interaction for all your linked information.

title: Experience Noeko Your Way: Self-Hosted and Premium
summary: We are thrilled to introduce Noeko's self-hosting option and flexible premium plans, empowering you with greater control and access to advanced features tailored for your success.

title: Stunning New Themes and Visual Upgrades
summary: Elevate your Noeko experience with an expanded array of beautiful themes, designed to give your workspace a fresh, personalized aesthetic.

title: Smarter Greetings for Your Day
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed greetings on your homepage, as we ensure our welcome messages always match your current time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly removing items directly from any tag's overview, making management simpler and faster.

title: Connect More of Your Knowledge
summary: We're enhancing our platform to accept a wider range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making it easier to gather all your valuable information in one place.
